newsitem.title: USA: CapStar buys airport hotel for $36.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: CapStar buys airport hotel for $36.5 mln.

text.p: CapStar Hotel Co said Wednesday it completed the acquisition of the 386-room Washington National Airport Hilton from privately-held U.S. Hotel Associates Inc for $36.5 million, and plans to spend $4 million for the hotel's renovation.

"The Washington market continues to expand," said Paul Whetsell, CapStar CEO. "We now own or manage nine properties in the Washington corridor and expect to see marketing and operating synergies that will benefit all of our hotels."

Since its initial public offering in August, CapStar has acquired 24 hotels in the United States and Canada. Its portfolio comprises 34 owned hotels with 8,715 rooms and 29 managed hotels with 5,154 rooms.
CapStar also said it expects to buy two more hotels within 30 days. The company added that it is actively seeking further acquisitions.
Capstar shares have posted strong gains since last year's IPO. The stock first sold for $18 each but was trading on Wednesday at 31-3/4, off 1/8.
